text:
cheng: heads up — seeing a spike in stalled gRPC streams between gpu-pool pods in eu-west-1 after the kernel upgrade this morning. streams hang for ~30-90s and then recover.

maria: any packetloss/err metrics?

cheng: retransmits and tcp_retrans_segs up on affected nodes. p99 request latency jumps. tcpdump shows lots of IP fragments and occasional ICMP 'Fragmentation needed' messages.

dan: can you paste `ip link` and the vxlan/overlay MTU from a node?

cheng: pasted snippets below — overlay dev is `vxlan0` created by our CNI, host eth has jumbo enabled on some nodes:

```
ip link show eth0
2: eth0: mtu 9000 qdisc mq state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff

ip link show vxlan0
11: vxlan0: mtu 1400 qdisc noqueue state UP mode DEFAULT group default qlen 1000
    link/ether 12:34:56:78:9a:bc brd ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff
```

cheng: host MTU 9000 vs overlay 1400 — that's expected, but after kernel bump we started seeing GSO/GRO + VXLAN interaction that yields large skbs getting silently dropped/fragmented.

irina: @netops — any upstream infra changes (hardware or provider) that would affect outer MTU or offload behaviour?

netops-bot: notice: kernel-6.6 rolled to nodes with label gpu=true in eu-west-1 at 2026-03-01T03:12Z (bumped offload defaults).

maria: ok, that aligns. common pattern: GSO produces large segments that the overlay can't encapsulate -> fragments -> conntrack/iptables sometimes drops or reorders -> HTTP2 windows stall -> gRPC stream hangs.

dan: can you try disabling GSO/GRO on the host as a quick test? command: `ethtool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off`

cheng: did that on one canary node — instantaneous improvement, streams stabilized. tcp_retrans_segs back to baseline.

maria: good quick test. long term we should either: (1) clamp CNI MTU to avoid fragments, (2) set kernel fallback `net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1` as a mitigation, or (3) fix offload handling in the host kernel/driver.

dan: I vote CNI MTU clamp + small canary rollout. also add a node annotation to track which kernel version has the offload change.

irina: netops: please coordinate kernel vendor with provider — we may need a driver patch. also open a support ticket with cloud vendor for the kernel-offload change.

netops-bot: ticket created: CLOUD-2345 "eu-west MTU/offload regression after kernel-6.6". assigned to netops.

cheng: immediate plan: patch CNI (vxlan mtu -> 1450) in staging, run 50-node canary, run perf + tcpdump checks, then roll to prod if green. I'll open an infra PR and add a runbook entry for disabling GSO as emergency mitigation.

maria: also add a health-check that looks for sustained high retransmits and a synthetic gRPC streaming test between gpu-pool pods.

dan: noted — will prepare kube rollout job + alert rule.

cheng: thanks all — taking the lead on the PR and runbook. will post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
